title: The Flannan Isles Keepers
idea: December 1900: three lighthouse keepers vanish from a rock in the Atlantic. The gate is shut, the clock has stopped, the lamps are ready, one set of oilskins still hangs inside. The official answer is a giant wave; the famous overturned chair is from a poem. Wave, or something else?
hook: In December 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished from an island with nowhere to go.
caption:
December 1900. Three lighthouse keepers vanish from Eilean Mòr, a rock in the Atlantic with nowhere to go. 🏮

The gate was shut. The clock had stopped. One set of oilskins still hung inside. The famous overturned chair? That came from a poem, years later.

WAVE or SOMETHING ELSE? Tell us what you think happened 👇🦊
first_comment: The official report blamed a giant wave. But why did one man run out in his shirtsleeves? WAVE or SOMETHING ELSE? 🌊🦊
